tools.name: raynetcrm_get_security_info
tools.description: Return the instance name, the user name and the user account id that the API key belongs to. Use it to confirm the connection. RAYNET CRM API: GET /security/info.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_companies
tools.description: List accounts (companies) in the CRM, with optional full-text search and paging. RAYNET CRM API: GET /company/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_get_company
tools.description: Get one company with its details and addresses. RAYNET CRM API: GET /company/{companyId}/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_persons
tools.description: List contact persons, with optional full-text search and paging. RAYNET CRM API: GET /person/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_get_person
tools.description: Get one contact person with the details. RAYNET CRM API: GET /person/{personId}/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_leads
tools.description: List sales leads, with optional full-text search and paging. RAYNET CRM API: GET /lead/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead with its details. RAYNET CRM API: GET /lead/{leadId}/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_deals
tools.description: List business deals (RAYNET CRM calls them business cases), with optional full-text search and paging. RAYNET CRM API: GET /businessCase/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_get_deal
tools.description: Get one business deal with its details. RAYNET CRM API: GET /businessCase/{businessCaseId}/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (to-dos), with optional full-text search and paging. RAYNET CRM API: GET /task/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_get_task
tools.description: Get one task with its details. RAYNET CRM API: GET /task/{taskId}/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_products
tools.description: List products in the product catalogue. RAYNET CRM API: GET /product/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_list_users
tools.description: List the user accounts of the instance. Use the ids as the owner of a lead or task. RAYNET CRM API: GET /userAccount/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_create_lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead in RAYNET CRM. The topic and priority are required. RAYNET CRM API: PUT /lead/.

tools.name: raynetcrm_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a new task in RAYNET CRM. The title, priority and owner are required. Link it to a person, company, lead or deal by id. RAYNET CRM API: PUT /task/.
